decisions.reason: The same-message Event already captures the visit scheduling and coordination clauses. Delaying HubSpot entry until arrangements are secured changes lead tracking, not the follow-up procedure.
The CRM-entry trigger applies after a host responds and a visit is secured; it does not change how initial host outreach is performed.
The source changes when an interested host is entered into HubSpot and does not change assignment quantities, deadlines, or completion expectations.
The Airbnb lead-tracking decision is unrelated to publishing products on Shopify.
The source describes the Airbnb scheduling and CRM workflow, not a change to the general initiative or independent-execution policy.
The source concerns entry of secured Airbnb leads into HubSpot, not cross-channel ecommerce product records.
The CRM-entry timing decision does not alter how ClickUp subtasks or goal parent tasks are marked.
The Airbnb lead-tracking change has no effect on CJ Dropshipping product research or selection criteria.
The source decision concerns secured Airbnb visit arrangements and HubSpot entry, not TikTok Shop product listing.
The timing of Airbnb lead entry into HubSpot does not change the Google Content Bank artifact or its intended use.
